title: Tiny, cute scooter
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='30' ry='4' fill='#2e3a5c'/>
  <!-- wheels -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='76' r='11' fill='#3ec5ff'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='76' r='6' fill='#1b6c96'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='76' r='2' fill='#bff0ff'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='76' r='11' fill='#3ec5ff'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='76' r='6' fill='#1b6c96'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='76' r='2' fill='#bff0ff'/>
  <!-- deck -->
  <rect x='28' y='60' width='44' height='9' rx='4' fill='#ff5a8a'/>
  <rect x='30' y='61' width='40' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ff9ab8'/>
  <!-- rear fender -->
  <path d='M60 62 Q78 58 82 70 L74 70 Q72 64 62 66 Z' fill='#ff5a8a'/>
  <!-- rear wheel guard -->
  <path d='M64 66 Q78 62 80 72' stroke='#ffb0c8' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- steering column -->
  <rect x='24' y='32' width='7' height='32' rx='3.5' fill='#ffd23e'/>
  <rect x='26' y='34' width='3' height='26' rx='1.5' fill='#fff0a8'/>
  <!-- front wheel fork -->
  <path d='M28 62 L28 70' stroke='#ffd23e' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- handlebar -->
  <rect x='14' y='28' width='30' height='7' rx='3.5' fill='#ffd23e'/>
  <rect x='16' y='29' width='26' height='2.5' rx='1.25' fill='#fff0a8'/>
  <!-- grips -->
  <rect x='12' y='26' width='6' height='11' rx='3' fill='#8be36b'/>
  <rect x='40' y='26' width='6' height='11' rx='3' fill='#8be36b'/>
  <!-- little headlight -->
  <circle cx='27' cy='44' r='4' fill='#fffbe0'/>
  <circle cx='27' cy='44' r='2' fill='#ffe27a'/>
  <!-- smiley on deck -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='64.5' r='1.4' fill='#4a1230'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='64.5' r='1.4' fill='#4a1230'/>
  <path d='M45 66.5 Q49 69 53 66.5' stroke='#4a1230' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
